data.description: The 7 ft Spiral Tunnel Slide drops from a steel tower through a red and yellow enclosed tube that winds round on itself. From this height the ride is long and quick, and children cannot see out until they reach the exit. It is a big draw for older children in schools, parks and resorts, and the enclosed tube keeps them inside the slide all the way down. A spiral uses less ground than a straight tunnel of the same height. Steel and moulded parts are warranted for 3 years against manufacturing defects. Tell us your site size and we will plan the tower, tube and exit on a layout drawing.

items.pText: The 7 ft Spiral Tunnel Slide drops from a steel tower through a red and yellow enclosed tube that winds round on itself. From this height the ride is long and quick, and children cannot see out until they reach the exit. It is a big draw for older children in schools, parks and resorts, and the enclosed tube keeps them inside the slide all the way down. A spiral uses less ground than a straight tunnel of the same height. Steel and moulded parts are warranted for 3 years against manufacturing defects. Tell us your site size and we will plan the tower, tube and exit on a layout drawing.

A galvanised tower supports the moulded tunnel sections. Our installers set it self-standing or grouted. The exit must sit where an adult can watch it, with rubber flooring underneath. Clear leaves and rainwater from the tube, and check every joint between tunnel sections during maintenance.
